cohort: 350 pregnant women admitted for delivery in the obstetrics and gynecology department of a tertiary care hospital.
finding: The prevalence of high-risk pregnancy was 26%, with previous cesarean section being the most common risk factor, and 13.97% of babies born to these pregnancies had low birth weight.
mod_finding: Lower segment cesarean section was performed in 75.82% of high-risk pregnancies, with 28.57% of those being emergency cesarean sections.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was reported in 13.97% of babies.
